faq.title: Answers before you start.
faq.intro: The most common questions before launching a MarketSoft project.

items.q: How long does it take to launch the platform?
items.a: The standard store is planned around one week, the advanced offer around ten days, and the marketplace between two and four weeks. Custom timing depends on the scope.
Yes. A payment method can be integrated depending on the package, country and selected provider.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. MarketSoft is designed to be deployed under your company identity and domain.
Yes. The architecture is designed to add capabilities, integrations, sellers, languages or points of sale progressively.
The platform can be hosted in the environment defined with you. The exact terms are specified in the offer and maintenance agreement.
The maintenance scope is defined according to the selected package and can cover monitoring, updates, backups, security and support.

items.q: Can I migrate my existing products?
items.a: Yes. Product migration can be planned depending on the format and quality of the source data.
Ownership, hosting and usage terms are defined contractually according to the selected project and support model.
